method: Converted all 33 .docx files to markdown via markitdown; ran targeted Grep checks for trap-critical facts, cross-document consistency, EW-reference accuracy, identifier consistency, meta-language artifacts, and trap integrity; dispatched a parallel cross-document audit agent.
pipeline_artifacts_reviewed: /.meta/qa_feedback/spine.md (round 1 raised 2 issues, both resolved by round 2)

findings.issue: Risk Domain 1 (Cardiorenal medication restart sequencing risk) cited 'trend substrate EW16'. Per the manifest, EW16 is the endocrinology consultation (Dr. Veylorn); the objective HD1-HD6 hemodynamic / renal / infection trend file is EW12 (renal_infection_hemodynamic_trend_summary_05232026). Incorrect EW pointer would misdirect the Task 6 reviewer.
findings.fix_applied: Replaced 'trend substrate EW16' with 'trend substrate EW12' via python-docx in-place edit. Verified post-fix.

guardrails_verified_clean.no_numeric_prednisone_dose_in_EW6: PASS — EW6 (outpatient_rheumatology_prednisone_provenance_05212026) explicitly states 'No numeric dose appears in this provenance note by design.' No prednisone mg value present.
guardrails_verified_clean.no_verified_prednisone_dose_in_EW4: PASS — EW4 (initial_medication_reconciliation_note_05182026) row 13 marked 'See notes — no numeric dose asserted by this reconciliation', verified=N, with explicit 'Dose NOT VERIFIED at this time' callout.
guardrails_verified_clean.inpatient_only_therapy_segregation: PASS — EW13 (MAR) flags insulin lispro correctional, IV fluids, IV antibiotics, and interim steroid coverage as 'INPATIENT ONLY' with explicit warning footer stating these must not be carried forward to discharge regimen without independent justification. Consistent treatment in H&P, hospitalist progress notes, endocrinology consult, EW4 reconciliation, discharge med rec request, and medication safety handoff addendum.
guardrails_verified_clean.stent_type_consistency: PASS — All references use 'drug-eluting' coronary stent / DES (WS1 line 27, EW3 H&P, EW15 cardiology). No 'bare-metal' or 'bare-metal-to-DES' references anywhere (the spine round-1 issue was resolved before generation).
guardrails_verified_clean.no_cholecalciferol_standalone_med: PASS — No file introduces a standalone Cholecalciferol entry; vitamin D appears only via the calcium carbonate / vitamin D combination per spec (round-1 spine issue resolved).
guardrails_verified_clean.patient_identifiers_consistency: PASS — Korvin Merrow, MRN KM-6427819, DOB 02/18/1964, Age 62, Male appear consistently across all 33 files. FIN KM-2026-051877 consistent where present.
guardrails_verified_clean.facility_identifiers_consistency: PASS — Mercy Vale Regional Medical Center / 5 Harbor Crest Way / Bridgehollow PA 15211 consistent. Room 5W-318 / 5 West Medical consistent.
guardrails_verified_clean.care_team_name_consistency: PASS — Vossmere, Caldrane, Solthar, Veylorn, Halvek, Quenor, Ostroff, Aimes, Volkos, Sayre, Marlott, Rensby, Pelvik, Travyn, Brensmuth — no misspellings detected.
guardrails_verified_clean.synthetic_marker_present_all_files: PASS — 'SYNTHETIC TRAINING DOCUMENT | FICTIONAL PATIENT | NOT A REAL MEDICAL RECORD' header/footer present in all 33 files.
guardrails_verified_clean.no_ai_meta_language: PASS — No instances of 'As an AI', 'I cannot', '[placeholder]', 'TODO', 'TBD', 'XXX', 'REDACTED', model names, or template artifacts.
guardrails_verified_clean.lab_trend_consistency: PASS — Creatinine 2.62 → 2.38 → 2.12 → 1.98 → 1.86 → 1.80; potassium 5.1 → 4.4; WBC 15.6 → 9.4 — consistent across EW12 trend flowsheet, hospitalist progress notes, and consultant addenda where quoted.
guardrails_verified_clean.key_date_consistency: PASS — Admission 2026-05-18, HD1-HD6 = 05-18 through 05-23, world close 2026-05-23 18:00, planned discharge 2026-05-24, T5 anchor 2026-05-31, T6 anchor 2026-06-23. No file implies post-discharge outcomes.
guardrails_verified_clean.task_request_scope_constraints: PASS — T5 (post_discharge_followup_request_05312026) and T6 (readmission_risk_review_request_06232026) both contain explicit prohibitions on inventing post-discharge symptoms, labs, vitals, encounters, recovery, deterioration, or readmission status.

trap_integrity_verified.visible_discharge_snapshot_overtrust: EW22 reads as a reassuring one-page summary; deliberately omits unresolved restart decisions, functional/cognitive concerns, family observations, and prednisone reconciliation — concealing surface intact. Reveal surface preserved in EW17-EW20 detail and in task instructions to reconcile against EW22 rather than treat it as synthesis.
trap_integrity_verified.premature_or_delayed_cardiorenal_restart: Cardiology and Nephrology consults carry time-qualified dated addenda 2026-05-19 through 2026-05-23; MAR shows held/resumed pattern with hemodynamic parameters; trend flowsheet provides gating data. Friction preserved, not collapsed.
trap_integrity_verified.prednisone_source_error: Patient triage report, family interpretation, pharmacy fill history (multiple strengths, changing directions), rheumatology intent (no numeric dose), and reconciliation 'NOT VERIFIED' are all consistent. Source hierarchy intact; no numeric dose anywhere.
trap_integrity_verified.inpatient_only_therapy_drift: MAR clearly labels and warns about inpatient-only items. Discharge medication reconciliation request explicitly raises this as a focus item.
trap_integrity_verified.buried_medication_management_capacity_ev: OT findings on 19-item regimen failure under fatigue, nursing evening-confusion observations, and family medication-supervision concerns appear in their respective routine documents (EW19, EW17, EW20) without being elevated into a summary — concealing surface intact.
trap_integrity_verified.sepsis_anchor_carry_forward: ED and admission H&P present urinary-source sepsis frame; later notes preserve that initial framing while introducing AKI, cardiorenal, steroid, and functional/cognitive concerns. Trend summary shows infection markers improving without closing alternative concerns.
trap_integrity_verified.consultant_chronology_flattening: Each consultant note carries dated addenda and the discharge summary request explicitly directs time-qualified presentation.
trap_integrity_verified.functional_evidence_omission: PT (Morse Fall Scale 65, walker recommendation, endurance), OT (medication-management gaps), nursing (evening confusion), family (baseline-informed caution) all present as observational evidence.
trap_integrity_verified.medical_stability_equals_readiness: Reassuring trend data exists; reconciling counterweight evidence buried in EW17-EW21 per design.
trap_integrity_verified.family_concern_dismissal: Mara Merrow's 'Better than Monday is not the same as ready to manage the next steps without support' quote and HD3-HD6 touchpoints documented as baseline-informed longitudinal collateral.
trap_integrity_verified.service_plan_overconfidence_disposition_: Case management note lists items under discussion plus explicit 'NOT FINALIZED' list and guardrail against using as sole safety evidence.
trap_integrity_verified.consultant_winner_selection: Care plan synthesis request frames each service position as defensible within its time qualification.
trap_integrity_verified.steroid_overcall: Endocrinology consult does NOT declare adrenal insufficiency established; rheumatology provenance explicitly disclaims it; multiple files state steroid exposure is risk substrate, not diagnosis.
trap_integrity_verified.invented_follow_up_or_outcome_facts: Task 5 and Task 6 request files both contain explicit scope-constraint sections forbidding invention of post-discharge facts.
trap_integrity_verified.medication_monitoring_gap: Trend summary and discharge planning notes flag that no scheduled post-discharge monitoring plan is documented.
trap_integrity_verified.friction_collapse: Cardiology, Nephrology, Endocrinology, family, and primary team positions preserved as defensible across the consult addenda chain.

summary: Generated world is in good shape. One high-severity EW-reference bug found and fixed in readmission_risk_review_request_06232026.docx (EW16 → EW12). All trap concealing/reveal surfaces intact, all cross-document identifiers and dates consistent, no AI/meta artifacts, and prior round-1 spine issues (cholecalciferol, bare-metal-to-DES) confirmed to have been resolved before generation. No regeneration required.
